name: long-paths
description: Enable Win32 long paths machine-wide (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem LongPathsEnabled = 1). Acquisition products moved to the shared area by UNC path exceed MAX_PATH (263 characters measured on mast00); without this the move fails and is retried forever. Windows reads the value at process start, so processes already running keep the limit until restarted. always:true because a value changed out of band produces no payload-hash drift. See #248.
